notes.title: Update 24: Livestock
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/ac9b559aa65fc1261cfa3172be3291d9312bc867.png"]

Hey everyone! Thanks so much for playing and supporting ACRES. This month is a big one, after months of hard work I'm rolling out the long-awaited Livestock Update and bringing the game to consoles! ACRES is now live on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One, with a Nintendo Switch release coming soon.

This marks the final major update before the official 1.0 launch on Steam, and we couldn’t have gotten here without your amazing support and feedback throughout Early Access. Thank you for helping shape ACRES into what it is today!


🌾 Update 24 Summary
8 New Animals

5 New Buildings

6 New Tractor Actions

5 New Crops

3 New Licenses

12 New Items

2 New Feeds

3 New Solid Fertilizer Types

7 New Order Products


🐄 New Animals
Your farm is now alive with livestock! Feed animals to fill their production bar. Once full, they’ll reward you with goods like milk, meat, eggs, and wool.

Each breed thrives on different crops, with unique preferences that affect how quickly they produce. Plan your feed carefully to maximize output.

No matter the breed, all animals can enjoy Hay, Silage, or graze freely on Ryegrass pastures.

Cows

Hereford – Beef

Angus – Beef

Holstein – Milk

Pigs

American Yorkshire – Pork

Black Iberian – Jamón

Chickens

Rhode Island Red – Poultry

Leghorn – Eggs

Sheep – Wool
Goats – Goat Milk


🏠 New Buildings[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/0d8955750e80b63b2a2ed511136982637c9f59df.png"]
Livestock Barn
A dependable way to raise large groups of animals. Livestock are fed daily with stored hay or silage, automatically producing meat, milk, eggs, and manure. Expanding the barn increases herd size and multiplies output, making it ideal for steady, reliable production.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/3d3c0ccd1600dafea7ce57ece5cc02f54b3d9484.png"]Free Range Shed
Raise animals the natural way for faster returns. Each animal roams freely, eating hourly from forage or cover crops. Additional feeders, fences, and gates can be placed to support them, offering a more active, field based approach to livestock care.

Animals actively search for food

Feeders are prioritized

Right Click returns animals to the barn

Hay Bale
Large round bale of hay, purchased locally. Can be placed to feed free range animals until it runs out, making it a simple way to keep livestock fed when pastures are limited.

Can be moved around with the move tool

Left-click adds to storage

Shift-click collects all bales until storage is full

Auto Feeder
Provides a steady food source for free range animals. Feed is supplied directly from your inventory, and the feeder can support up to six animals at once. Useful for supplementing pastures or giving animals an extra boost when natural forage is limited.

Feed types: Hay, Silage, Wheat, Barley, Rye, Corn, Triticale, Carrots, Radish

Left Click to change feeds

Silage Silo
Make and store fermented silage for livestock feed.

Converts 3 green + 2 brown plant material into Silage every 64 hours

Holds up to 128 Silage



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/c688bb554f02fa27831bfd177d41fdb65618b63b.png"]
🌱 New Crops
Oats – Cash Crop

Cereal Rye – Cash Crop

Triticale – Cash Crop

Alfalfa – Cover Crop & Pasture feed

Ryegrass – Cover Crop & Pasture feed
📦 New Items
Livestock Products: Beef, Pork, Poultry, Jamón, Wool, Milk, Goat Milk
Feeds:

Hay: Can be purchased by placing a Hay bale in the field. Can also be generated on farm from weeds and bale able crops (Wheat, Barley, Rye, Corn, Triticale)

Silage: Produced and stored in Silage Silo from green and brown plant material.
💩 New Solid Fertilizer Types
Barnyard Manure – From cows & pigs. Must decompose before harvest.

Pellet Manure – From sheep & goats. Safe for direct field use.

Slurry – Composted barnyard manure. Richer soil values, safe for harvesting.
📜 New Licenses
Livestock Goods Permit – Adds Milk, Wool, Goat Milk to orders.

Butchery Trade Permit – Adds Beef, Pork, Poultry, Jamón to orders.

Daily Fuel Purchase – Auto-refills tanks each morning.

Lvl 1: 25% | Lvl 2: 50% | Lvl 3: 75% | Lvl 4: 100%


🚜 New Tractor Actions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/efa985e599e7abe77c5d7b9815496d5677cf27d5.png"]

Baling

Turns weeds and grasses into compact hay bales ready for storage or livestock feed. 

Produces a Bale for every 10 Hay harvested

Crops: Wheat, Barley, Rye, Corn, Triticale

Weeds yield a small amount

Crop maturity increases Hay yield

Progress meter visible in right-side menu



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/c2760e4d4a8418f529ea36f2b2eed8b53582f3fd.png"]


🧭 Custom Fields
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/1ef1ab8ac70674c2724f55e5e3c3d09bf3e9dd16.png"]

Design your own plots for precision farming. Unlocks custom X-Tools for plowing, sowing, cultivating, fertilizing, harvesting, and baling.

Placed with a Custom Field Marker

Extend / Shrink Height or Width with Primary/Secondary Action

Size display for quick alignment

Can be moved and removed

Enables use of X tools. Plow, Seed, Cultivate, Harvest, Liquid Fertilizer, Solid Fertilizer and Baler all have a custom field tool available.

Like other field actions, the largest implement owned is used. Will use smaller width versions on smaller custom fields. IE. Will use a single row plow if the field is only 2 rows wide. 


🎮 Controller Improvements
Change tools instantly with D-Pad left/right

No longer need to press D-Pad down first to enter tool selection row

Access menus with face buttons while tools are selected

New hotkeys:

X / ▢: Left Tractor & tool settings Menus

Y / △: Right Crop & Item selection Menus

D-Pad Down: Pause / Resume Game

LT + D-Pad Up : Toggle inventory window

LT + D-Pad Down : Toggle soil data window

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/424153b1265a4cb22591e0371c02db2765689e04.png"]

New music - 15 fresh tracks by Luca Tomassini

Harvestable data overlay - Shows all currently harvestable cells and blocks out others when clicked. Shows next action needed on button

CSA items can now be sold out for wholesale storage

Increased time in harvest stage on F2 forage crops

⚙️ Quality of Life
Automated seed changer: Set seed with current selection with Secondary Action

Buildings will turn red during initial placement if blocked 

New Setting: Show Building Widgets At Center Screen. 

	- On by default for Steam Deck & Switch

	- This puts the world widgets in the same spot to the right of the cursor rather than over the building when hovering

- All crop and item decals packed into texture atlas. No longer needs dynamic shader for each type or building. Greatly reduces draw calls and GPU lookup dependency

notes.title: Update 23: Tractor Dispatch & Leaderboards
notes.content:
ACRES: Update 13 Patch Notes
This patch introduces new features, quality-of-life improvements, and performance optimizations to enhance your farming experience. Here's what's new:


New FeaturesTractor Dispatch Post
Assigns a Farmhand to oversee a row using tractors.

Queues a new tractor action every morning at sunrise based on the placed cell's needs.

Expandable area adds an endpoint to the tractor’s task route for seamless automation.

Unlocks at 150 Reputation Points.

Cost: $1,000,000 per post.

New: Change seed type after placement (also applies to Farmhand Task Post).

Simplifies end-game automation for larger farms.
Steam Leaderboards
Compete globally in the following categories:

Total Farm Size (Acres)

Days Operating

CSA Members

Bank Account Balance

Accessible via the ACRES Steam Community: View Leaderboards.

Updates when returning to the main menu.
Gameplay ImprovementsOrder System Updates
New Setting: "Sell Orders One at a Time" option in Game Settings. When enabled, only the first order is attempted for sale, preventing automatic cycling through all orders.

Manual Sell Option: Sell an order manually if items are reserved for an earlier order. Look for the green checkmark button to confirm availability.
Save Game Enhancements
Save Metadata: Now includes slot name, days operating, account balance, total acres, and save timestamp for easier tracking.

Improved UI: Reformatted save selection buttons for clearer readouts.

Faster Loading: Optimized file parsing for quicker save/load times.

Seamless Slot Switching: No delays when swapping save slots in the load menu.

Backward Compatibility: Older saves fallback to slower loading if new metadata is absent.

Controller Support: Cycle save slots using L1/R1 on controllers.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/65435f8680dfe0f4234bf5319a201b73294e1fa7.png"]
Additional Performance Optimizations
Tractor Barns: Implemented spatially instanced meshes for better performance.

Cosmetic Data Caching: Save data only updates when changes occur, significantly improving save times, especially for large farms or starting forest maps.
Quality of Life Improvements
Worker Hover: Ignored for workers assigned to stations, reducing UI clutter and preventing blocking overlap.

Tractor Movement: Tractors now stop on cells with cosmetic items. Enables ability to control row stop points with paths or trees.

New Game Menu Redesign: Custom settings moved to the right; handheld consoles (Steam Deck, Switch) hide detailed graphics settings for simplicity.

Weather: Increased chance of clear skies in Spring for better farming conditions.

Auto-Save: Default frequency changed from 1 minute to 5 minutes.

Fuel Storage: Added secondary action widget to indicate upgradability.

Controller Support:

Scroll crop tooltip details with the right thumbstick.

Cycle save slots with L1/R1.

UI Enhancements:

Updated guide text for PlayStation.

Path area icon changed to match in tooltips.

Top bar extra details hidden on Steam Deck and Switch.

Tool tooltips adjust dynamically based on bottom bar height.

Custom Text Scaling: New setting (0.8x–2.0x) to adjust text size for key UI elements without resizing the entire interface.
Bug Fixes
Tractor Scheduler: Fixed 24:00 hour display, now resets to 0:00.

Input Fix: Resolved double-bond input issue for F1; debug stats toggle moved to F9.

Controller Navigation: Improved navigation in the tractor scheduler for smoother control.

Thank you for your continued support! I hope these changes make your time in ACRES more enjoyable. Share your feedback on the Steam Community or our social channels!

Happy farming!
Jimi

notes.title: Update 22: Farmhand Automation
notes.content:
While I’m hard at work preparing for the 1.0 launch and console release - where the long awaited Livestock Update will arrive - I wanted to put together a meaningful update for everyone playing on Steam in the meantime. This patch adds a powerful new automation tool, the Farmhand Task Post, plus a bunch of quality-of-life improvements, controller enhancements, and performance tweaks to make your farming smoother and more satisfying as we head toward full release.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/c70dab629eee88018b8fb86ac88cbaa31db97654.png"]New: Farmhand Task Post
Take a break from the grind—let your farmhands do the heavy lifting!

Automate entire rows of crops: sowing, watering, harvesting—fully hands-off.

Automatically applies fertilizers if necessary.

Assign or unassign a farmhand to toggle activity.

Default coverage: 1 cell. Use:

Right-click to extend range up to 16 additional acres.

Shift + Right-click to shrink it

Easily reposition to different rows for dynamic gameplay.

Unlocks at 50 Rep points

Costs $50,000 per post

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/76b4431fd684a6eecdbe4c238356c535a01c42a5.jpg"]
Controller & Steam Deck Enhancements
Haptic feedback added for controllers and Steam Deck.

Controls preview on pause screen dynamically reflects input device (Keyboard, Steam Deck or controller based on platform).

Circular navigation enabled in pause menu.

New controller shortcuts:

Right Thumbstick Button – Switch camera view

Right Thumbstick Button + LT/L2 – Toggle grid

Left Thumbstick Button – Go to home

Left Thumbstick Button + LT/L2 – Go to next field
Quality of Life Improvements
The Copy hotkey (Default: "C" , Controller Y / △) now also copies any crop to the current selection, making it faster to match crop types across your farm.

Copying a Seed Bin now only copies the seed type—without switching to the placement tool—making it easier to quickly plant the same crop without accidentally placing a new bin.

The Move hotkey now automatically selects the currently highlighted placeable, reducing extra clicks when repositioning structures.

Purchasing a Tool popup dialogue box displays clearer error message when funds or rep points are insufficient.

Device Tooltips now displays input bindings for each action.

HUD cleanup:

Moved Reputation bar to top of the screen for better visibility across platforms.

Removed game mode icon from top-left corner for a cleaner interface.

Improved readability on maximized Soil Data widget.

Now displays live crop growth rates and other dynamic stats.

Still able to minimalize or minimize bottom widget completely.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/7d0d0fbdb0df80e61b31a0a0b25e2d94865e088f.png"]
Gameplay & System Changes
Added +1 Rep Point preview on potential orders to clarify rewards.

Farmhand task speed reduced to balance with tractor workflows.

Daily wage increases now scale with number of Worker Housing buildings.

Camera can now zoom in closer for detailed views.

Increased frequency of clear skies and rain; reduced other weather types like cloudy or fog.

Beehive and Chicken Run now unlock with just 1 Rep.

“New Journey” achievement now triggers when starting a new game (no longer on main menu load).

Steam Deck automatically set graphics preset and UI Scale 110% on initial start.

Top secret cheat code added (you didn’t hear it from me).

Removed MP4 intro videos for faster boot and login across platforms.

Display user’s platform name in the main menu, ensuring proper sync with cloud saves and achievement tracking.

Action queue widgets capped at 25 to improve performance when assigning large Farmhand areas.

Package size reduced to 1.48 GB.

Official Chinese health warning now appears if language is set to Simplified or Traditional Chinese.
Bug Fixes
Fixed pause menu overlapping tutorial elements.

Corrected controller icon alignment on the left menu.

Copied building updates category selection on HUD.

Planter seed selection widget updates on new crop selected delegate

Resolved issue with tutorial breaking if "Back" was pressed during a popup with controller.

Fixed issue preventing pause when Farm Details is open while using a controller.

Farmhands now correctly use assigned amendment, not the currently selected one.

Fixed stuck pause hotkey caused by overlay button focus lock.

Soil Data widget now displays accurate info when using crop variants.

Potentially fixed a crash caused when a settings menu is opened repeatedly.

Proper mesh displayed when moving the seed changer.

Improved order processing visuals:

Refresh all field renderers when processing new orders. Helps clear any lingering plants or notification indicators.

Press F5 to manually refresh visuals.

Stricter reference assignment on placed items, reducing risk of save data corruption resulting in duplicate buildings on load.

As always, Thanks for playing
-Jimi

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/fd54996810d459da2d0bc181ff23e0121b9b02e0.jpg
👨‍🌾Farmhands Update
Introducing the new Farmhand system—a game-changer for large-scale farming! Hire and manage workers to tackle manual tasks across multiple acres with ease.
Core Farmhand Features

Worker Management: Assign farmhands to tasks across your farm simultaneously via a dynamic task queue.
New Tool Categories: Farmhands bring optional tools for each task type—Plow, Sow, Cultivate, Amend, and Harvest—designed for multi-cell operations. (Classic instantaneous single-cell manual tools remain available!)

notes.title: ACRES Update 19: Field Expansion
notes.content:
Acres Update 19 Patch Notes

I'm thrilled to announce that Update 19 is here! This update focuses on expansion, optimization, and gameplay enhancements, introducing the all-new Fields system. With Fields, you can manage your acres more efficiently, enjoy smoother performance, and scale your farms to unprecedented sizes.

New Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f6e6f01e0137bcf1c8cf876516807555c2a29b9f.jpg

Fields System

Fields are at the heart of Update 19, transforming the way you manage your farm with a focus on efficiency and scalability. Here’s an in-depth look at what makes Fields so impactful:


What Are Fields?
 Fields are predefined clusters of 60x60 acres designed to provide a larger operational area, making it easier to manage expansive farms efficiently.

Field Operations:
 Each major tool type now has field operation variants to match the preexisting 1-row, 3-row, and 5-row counterparts, ensuring seamless integration with existing equipment.
 Assign actions to entire fields for streamlined task execution.
 Quarter-field operations allow for precise 30x30-acre tasks, enabling detailed management when needed.
 Tools automatically select the largest available implement to optimize operations. For example, if you own a 3-row plow and later purchase a 5-row plow, the system will prioritize the 5-row plow for field operations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/4dc32508a0bbc106a733f82965e9a25c49163eab.jpg

Visualization:
 During field operations, the entire field is highlighted in a tool-specific color, matching the row highlights.
 Blue box indicators mark the starting cells for each row, while red indicators show the planned stopping cells.

Performance Enhancements:
 The Fields system decouples rendering from the game cycle, allowing for quicker render times and smoother gameplay.
 Supports larger farms by improving performance. Benchmark testing demonstrates:
   100k crops over 90k acres running at ~120+ FPS (3440 x 1440 on epic settings).
   Compared to Update 18, which managed only 30-60 FPS at this scale.

Field Indexing:
 Fields are indexed to simplify navigation and task management. The grid-based system makes it easy to locate and organize fields.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/580b8b6d68a43bfb471407a96cdea87744fe1e60.png
Tractor Action Queue


Actions are queued when all tractors are occupied, retriggering once a tractor becomes available.
Highlights queued actions on the field and displays details via the action widget, including:
- Required tool.
- Assigned tractor.
- Acre and field indices.
Queue Management:
- Collapse the queue for a cleaner interface.
- Cancel individual actions or clear the entire queue via right-click options.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/7ecbe35934d9861525e9b5798c7a0511f8e61b5d.jpg
Weekly Profit/Expense Reports


Visualize income and expenses by type.
Accessible through top navigation for easy financial tracking.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/880162cae5c0149ff9db85f073d3c27ad459de18.jpg
Gameplay Enhancements

Distance Icons: View acre progress clearly when zoomed out, thanks to new ready markers.
Customizable Transition Ranges: Adjust rendering transition settings to suit your preferences.
Increased Camera Range: Zoom out further to accommodate larger farms and gain a better overview.
World Notifications: Notifications now appear at specific action cells within acres instead of the HUD, improving context and visibility.
Slow-Pan Camera Movement: Move the camera smoothly to specific locations for a better navigation experience.
Hotkey to Cycle Fields: Quickly switch between fields for faster task management.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/1196628832cf6ce26864080695361d1cb87e28c9.jpg

Quality of Life Improvements


Seed Bin Capacity: Increased to support larger operations.
Fill fuel buttons: Fuel buttons now fill in relation to capacity. Fill full, adding half capacity and +1/4 (Previously in 10, 100, 1000 increments)
Tax Adjustment: Reduced tax rate from 8.3% to 7.3%, mapped for farms up to 100k acres.
Crisper Row Visualization: Improved row indicators for tractor action tools.
Improved Widget Layouts:
- Crop selection widget updated to a 3-wide layout for quicker selection.
- Order buttons now scroll when overfilled, preventing blocked crop buttons.
Notification Improvements:
- Notifications resized and moved to the top right for better visibility.
- "Storage full" replaces "Cannot add to storage" for clearer communication.
Save Icon Update: Relocated to the bottom right and increased in size for easier access.


---

Bug Fixes


Resolved an issue with two songs playing on startup.
Fixed crop selection being blocked by inventory dropdowns.
Corrected seed bin widget icon overlapping price text at lower resolutions.
Weeds clearing no longer requires batch update calls.
Extended functionality for perennial crops with gamepad support.


---

Optimizations


Rendering Improvements:
- Frustum culling for fields out of view
- Reduced main menu render complexity and startup times.
- Vertex scaling for crops now GPU-powered.
Global Widget Performance: Placeable global widgets now share a universal widget, enhancing performance with multiple instances.
DLSS Upgrade: Upgraded to DLSS 3.7.20 SDK for better visual fidelity and performance.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/a1fff7212a75441d98d7fafc08ade33a1d8163e4.jpg

Update 19 marks a significant leap forward for Acres, empowering players with new tools, smoother gameplay, and unmatched scalability. Dive in and start expanding your farm today!

notes.title: Year in Review, Update 19 Progress, and the Road to 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're all having a wonderful holiday season! I want to take a moment to thank you for playing Acres, all the great feedback and to reflect on what has been an incredible year of updates and growth.

2024 Yearly Recap
This year brought a host of exciting updates:


 Update 12: Performance improvements and the Soil Data HUD
 Update 13: Compost & Manure mechanics Update 14: Taxes, custom keybindings, and gamepad support
 Update 15: Nutrient & Multiplier data overlays
 Update 16: Hardcore mode, row highlights, and DLSS support
 Update 17: The Berry Update
 Update 18: Landscaping tools and cosmetic upgrades


Update 19 Progress
I’m thrilled to share that Update 19 is on track for release in January! This update is all about expansion and optimization with the introduction of Fields.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f570a94d925de3492a152eb3addeb7384bce686b.png
Fields are 60x60 clusters of acres designed to streamline gameplay. They allow you to assign and queue actions on a larger scale while enabling quicker render times. Rendering is now fully decoupled from the game cycle and managed at the field level, resulting in smoother performance and the ability to support much larger farms.

As a result, with some benchmark testing, I was able to get 100k crops operating on over 90k Acres! 
Performing ~120+ FPS at 3440 x 1440 on epic settings. To compare I have loaded the same save file into U18 which ran between 30-60FPS at that kind of scale.
[previewyoutube=IFEukXmevWI;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready for Update 19
The following features have been completed and will be included:

 Distance icons: Visualize acre progress more clearly when zoomed out
 Customizable transition ranges: Adjust these settings in-game to suit your preferences
 Tractor action queue: When all tractors are used, additional actions are save to a queue and retriggered as tractors become available.
 Weekly profit/expense reports : Visualize income and costs tracking by type
 Slow-pan camera movement to specific locations
 Hotkey to cycle between field locations
 World notifications at action cells: Messages can appear at each Acres rather than on the hud
 Increased camera range: Allowing creation of larger farms


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/580b8b6d68a43bfb471407a96cdea87744fe1e60.png


Additionally Planned for Update 19
These features are currently in progress:


 Assigning actions to entire fields
 Increased seed bin capacity
 Upgradeable fuel tanks for tractors
 Optional tractor stop location assignments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/85f73b5a505b50283148713620bbd6bb37b8607b.png

Road to 1.0
Update 19 isn’t just another content drop—it’s a transformative step forward for Acres. The systems introduced in this update form the foundation that will support the major features planned for the game's full release. With the performance enhancements and scalability provided by the new Fields system, larger farms can now operate seamlessly, enabling me to shift focus toward building out exciting new gameplay mechanics.

Here’s what lies ahead on the road to version 1.0:


 The Workers Update:
 This update will introduce NPC workers, bringing a new layer of strategy and efficiency to your farm. Assign tasks to your workforce and optimize operations to maximize productivity across your fields.

 The Automation Update:
 Say goodbye to micromanagement with streamlined farming processes. Automation systems will allow players to set up workflows that handle routine tasks, giving you more time to focus on growth and planning.

 The Animal Update:
 Expand your farm into the world of livestock management. From breeding and feeding to optimizing yields, this update will enrich gameplay with new challenges and opportunities tied to animal husbandry.


These updates build directly on the scalable systems introduced in Update 19, ensuring that Acres is ready to grow in both scope and depth. Each planned addition is designed to bring new life to your farm while maintaining the smooth performance and large-scale farming capabilities that Update 19 makes possible.

The journey to 1.0 is an exciting one, and I can’t wait to share it with you!

Post 1.0 Vision
Acres is a personal project, and while there are no guaranteed updates planned beyond its release, I have some exciting ideas I’d love to explore in the future. Potential additions include:


 Irrigation Systems: Streamlined water management for your fields
 Seasonal Mechanics: Dynamic weather and crop cycles
 Pest Management: Challenges to test your farming skills
 More Crops & Fruit Trees: Expanding your farm with additional perennial crops


Thank you for being a part of this amazing journey. I can’t wait to share more updates and continue growing Acres together!

Happy Holidays,
Jimi @ Jimi Games

notes.title: ACRES U18: Landscaping & Cosmetics Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e2cf5060bad17ed584ce873178751af1adec7797.jpg
Patch Notes: U18 Landscaping Update
Introducing the U18 Landscaping Update, a comprehensive overhaul that elevates both the functionality and visual appeal of your farm. This update brings a range of new tools, decorative items, and quality of life features designed to enhance your farming experience. From the lush surrounding forests that add depth to your environment, to the new Subsoiler Plow that optimizes soil health, and the versatile landscaping tools that allow for greater customization, every aspect of your farm can now be tailored to your unique vision. Whether you're focused on aesthetics, efficiency, or both, the U18 update has something to offer for every farmer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/95a06e96ccbaf9ccbad2dba6218c03538c7dce8a.png
Introducing Surrounding Forest & Environmental Enhancements

 The farm’s backdrop now features a lush surrounding forest, adding depth and a sense of progression as you expand your acreage.
 Trees in the surrounding forest are automatically cleared upon purchasing a new acre but can also be removed manually using the new Cosmetic Area Tool or the Remove Placeable Tool.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e6cc69dc44d6f6e2a6cbf674bf2ab382c5497d6f.jpg
New Subsoiler Plow Implement

 A powerful new tool, the Subsoiler, is now available for deeper plowing and soil compaction repair.
 In standard mode, the Subsoiler restores soil compaction up to 130%, with even greater results if ‘Minimal Soil Effects’ is selected in custom game settings.
 Priced at $71,560.00 with a $95 per-use cost, the Subsoiler offers a more efficient but slightly costlier option than traditional soil rebuilding methods.
 Requires 105 HP and plows one row at a time, ideal for those looking to optimize soil health.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/b710a86b6b796d18e8aece568a883efbb344964a.jpg
New Tool Category: Landscaping

 The Landscaping category brings a variety of decorative tools to customize and beautify your farm.
 Single Ornament Tool: Place individual decorative items such as Potted Plants, Benches, and Ornamental Trees to enhance your farm’s aesthetic.
 Path Tool: Create ground paths between two points to design clear walkways.
 Area Path Tool: Fill an entire area with ground tiles between selected corners.
 Fence Tool: Erect fences along paths; fences will automatically update based on adjacent cells.
 Gate Tool: Add gates to your fences for easy access; gates can be rotated and opened with the action modifier and secondary action buttons.
 Remove Cosmetics Area Tool: This tool allows you to clear all decorative items within a specified area. You can also opt to include buildings and fences in the removal process via the settings menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/585cadc2e8993dc107044d35358bc69b4377f08b.jpg
Landscaping Type Selections
Selecting different types for each landscaping tool can be done in the right hand side menu.

Landscaping Settings
Each tool also has different settings available located on the left hand side menu

 Suppress Weeds: Opt to automatically dampen weeds underneath the placed item.
 Block Cell: Choose whether the place item blocks the cell from other activities on the farm. Useful for creating tractor stops when the stop on failed action setting is enabled
 Randomize rotation: If enable rotates the next item randomly
 Size: Change the placed size of selected ornamental items
 Remove buildings and fences: Option to choose if buildings and fences are also removed with this tool. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/d62d8fd1579261eb003a66ceab38e07bbbcbbea4.jpg
Farm Asset Details & Scalable Loans

 Loans now scale with your farm’s total asset value, which includes acres, buildings, and placed landscaping items.
 A detailed asset breakdown is available in the Finances tab, helping you manage your finances more effectively.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/6cce8dbdb498d4302d11e860c30779ab7bbfbf1e.jpg
Home Barn Floor Upgrades
The Home Barn floor can now be upgraded with five different pathing styles. Spend your Rep points in the License tab to clear those pesky weeds and upgrade to sand, gravel, stone, or a concrete slab.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/3136ed0a62b66d204245fb41503d7a28422e721e.jpg


Rotatable Buildings & Improved Move Tool
	
 Buildings can rotate with the action modifier key. Default keybinding: "R", "Left Shift" & Gamepad LT
 Direction can also be changed after placement with the move tool.
 The Buildings can also now be moved into areas that were previously occupied by itself. Helpful for moving a placeable small distances
 Object size and rotation are now displayed during movement.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e2b4c4a5c340aa47c0aa2a8603c1300b0a3abc66.jpg

Tractor Quality of Life Improvements

 Tractors now display a warning icon above the tractor in the field in addition to the popup message on the GUI when the implement has failed. This includes situations such as a seeder has run out of seeds, a cell is blocked, a harvester encounters unready crops or storage is full.
 Tractor ‘stop on failed action’ button icon has changed to match the new warning icon. 
 If 'stop on failed action' is enabled (red) Harvesters will stop processing when the storage is full. This can be toggled by pressing the button in the tractor type selection menu or using the default hotkey T, 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/1ac02e607fb1525f99fe40f23269f04606d043a8.jpg


Grid & Placement Aides

 A new hotkey (V) quickly toggles between a top-down view and the default perspective.
 The grid has been raised for better visibility over weeds and crops.
 Object size and rotation are now displayed during movement.
 A red blocked icon appears in the cell details HUD when hovering over blocked acres.


Additional Quality of Life Improvements

 Weeds can now be cleared from blocked cells using the manual cultivator tool, even under buildings and placeables.
 Notification icons have been updated for clearer, quicker messages.
 The arrow from the tractor control device during placement has been removed to prevent confusion; it now functions in both directions.

Performance Optimizations & Bug Fixes

 Dynamic shadow rendering for lower video quality settings can now be toggled under “Enable Detailed Shadows.”
 Removed redundant Z-height line trace calls for improved performance.
 Fixed the ‘Restart’ button on the game-over screen to properly restart in the original mode rather than endless mode.

Update 18 brings both visual and functional enhancements to ensure a more immersive and enjoyable farming experience. Happy farming! - Jimi

notes.title: ACRES Update 17: The Berry Bonanza!
notes.content:
The Berry Update U17 Patch Notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/ff517ccd1e6c01401978708ea6a853cb9871bb42.jpg
The berry update brings berries, jam, a specialized berry harvester, variable yields + numerous quality of life and farm changes.

New Perennial Crops
ACRES now supports perennial crops, which regrow after harvesting but require specialized equipment. These crops can be selected in the seed menu below cover crops.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/7e451cc540162f4f09522d02b5f7eb7036baa1ea.png

New crops include: Blackberry, Strawberry, Blackcurrant, Raspberry, Blueberry and Salak ( Snake Fruit).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e1f5aab7bcb77e4440604349b2b66e7b3efc95f8.jpg

Berry Harvester Implement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/833f001ec02a7bf5db8218d094e53a8234712452.png
To harvest the new berry crops, use the new Berry Harvester Implement or the berry picker tool. The Berry Harvester is tractor-pulled, occupies one row, and preserves the main plant for subsequent harvests.


Jam Processor Building
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/692f42cd73875e0c40295d9807efaad4adf52f7e.jpg
Turn your harvested berries into sellable packaged goods with the new Jam Processor building. You can produce:

 Blackberry Preserves
 Blackcurrant Jam
 Strawberry Jelly
 Raspberry Jam
 Blueberry Jelly


Cottage Foods Permit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/7b129669caa8b4b05a1c67a89f243211912bc376.jpg
The Cottage Foods Permit, required for jam processing, can be unlocked in the license tab. Once unlocked, jam items will become available in incoming orders. Upgrade the permit to increase the number of jam items in orders.

Increased item order amounts
The amount of non-crop items (e.g., eggs, oils, jams) requested in orders now scales with the amount of acres owned and the current license level.

Tractor & Implement Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/5582f4471c5ea15cb7e77d07acdbaf806896f14c.png
New Implement Horsepower Requirements
Implements now have horsepower requirements, requiring larger tractors for bigger and heavier implements. For example, 50 HP is required to use a 3 row disk plow and any tractor with more than 50HP is able to use it. Icons have been added to each implement's tooltip for a quick reference. As before if "Auto Select next available tractor type" is enabled in the game settings, choosing the tool we automatically use a capable tractor is the current one is not selected.

Tractor Speed and Cost Adjustments
Tractors have also received and increase in speeds and cost. Faster almost double speeds will help manage crops further down the rows easier. 

The harvest wagon model pulled next to the harvesters also received a much needed update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/4ccc99a207dc8122878249919262c91f3bca9198.jpg

Variable Yields & Stress Changes
Crops no longer guarantee maximum yields. Yield outcomes depend on plant health and final stress levels. The potential harvest range is shown in the seed tooltip, with maximum yield at zero stress and minimum yield at high stress. The current stress level for each plant is displayed with a red bar in the bottom right menu under the crop's progress bar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f16b439583e5947b13691b63d5aec4b1a5f18d8d.jpg

Stress also no longer reduces in each plant after being affected. Effects final yield amounts.

Land Area tools
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/6dfaf8ee7e93d46a2fcd5ae1951fefc0b28d1d4a.jpg
New tools are now available to dynamically purchase and sell acres of varying sizes by drawing a box. Clicking once select the first corner and clicking a second time selects the opposing corner, finalizing the selection and attempts the action.

Additional Farm Changes

 Increased tax rates for larger farms
 Increased seed bins levels available
 Increased tractor speeds and prices
 In Endless mode an additional rep point is added every 7 days in operation

Quality of Life Improvements

 Detailed storage Item list is now organized by type and scrollable
 Cell purchase widget : non scaling screen space
 All available recipes for processor buildings are displayed on the tool tooltip
 Increased size and added icon for stress level bar in bottom right corner
 Reduced background plant amount in main menu for better startup performance
 Changed oil refinery widget to non scaling screen space for better visibility at all zoom levels
 Update beehive modifier data overlay after placing a new hive
 Icon in tooltip next to tool name
 Display secondary icon for max surplus messages to show which crop or item is over without relying on secondary notification surplus sold
 Do not withdraw money if cell already owned when purchasing allowing for less careful purchasing needed

Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug when loading from save that marked certain dead crops as harvestable
 Quicker render updates on soil after selling acre
 Top corner of tilled soil mesh no longer produces graphical glitching due to weed overlap
 Possible game crash from invalid crop renderer pointer if render update was pending
 Hovering over price history select buttons with the mouse no longer scrolls the whole section into view making it easier to select.

A new action type is available in the soil amendment tool category. The Solid Fertilizer Spreader applies new solid fertilizer types for an additional way to take care of your acres. Solid fertilizers can be applied manually or with the new Solid Fertilizer Row Spreader. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/4dfd53d261ddbfc3207fcd380d8ca66d866f7702.jpg

Solid Fertilizers require items from the farm’s inventory rather to be used instead of money like the liquid amendment types. Solid Fertilizer items can be produced on the farm, and the amount of each on hand is displayed on the right hand menu selection button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/d07334af0b59fff589fdccf978af154e3469b81b.png

When applied, Solid fertilizers take time to decompose and slowly release nutrients back into the soil. Each fertilizer type applies different nutrient values and has unique output curve profiles. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/78aa7372e2786e3118ebbf8a4cb6f20e968c90d4.jpg

Solid fertilizer cannot be stacked in the fields, applying additional fertilizer of the same type will reset the progress to 100% and the excess will runoff and be lost.

Solid fertilizers can have additional properties such as weed suppression or can be hazardous. These affects and applied throughout the lifespan of the fertilizer until it has completely decomposed.

 Solid fertilizers decompose over time, releasing nutrients gradually into the soil.
 Each fertilizer type has unique nutrient values and distinct output curve profiles.
 Detailed data for each type is available in the right-hand selection menu tooltip.

Crops can now add additional items, green & brown plant material during harvest. The amount of these items varies per crop and is displayed in the seed tooltip. Advancing each crop’s hybrid research can increase the amount of additional plant material during harvest up to 3 times the original amount.
Plant material is useful for creating compost and mulch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/2878948b08e8ff1245bfd09568abe026e358a62a.jpg

Chicken Runs and Large Coop’s now produce chicken manure. Chicken manure is collected into the farm’s storage system for each graze cycle. Chicken manure can be applied directly to the fields or composted with brown plant material for additional soil benefits.

Plant Compost: Created from 12 green and 8 brown plant material. Compost takes 18 hours to produce.
Composted Chicken Manure: Created from 8 brown plant material and 4 Chicken Manure. Takes 67 hours to produce.

Multiple compost stations can be built at a time. When a recipe is selected, the station will automatically pull the required ingredients out of storage. When all ingredients have been pulled composting will proceed. Items highlighted in red in the station world widget indicate that the item is still needed, while highlighted white indicates the item has already been pulled. The progress bar and green arrow show the current active cycle progress while a red arrow indicates the station is currently inactive.

notes.title: Wholesale Selling, Automatic Chicken Feeder & Oil Press Enhancements
notes.content:
Patch Notes - 0.23.1120

Hi All, I've been busy this week working on a new way to sell wholesale items, added the much requested automatic chicken feeder and a few other quality life improvements for ACRES. I've been trying to create a good balance between adding new features and improving the current systems with these updates. Thank you all for playing, and Happy Farming! 


Wholesale Item Selling Overhaul

Efficient Selling: Items can now be sold more efficiently from the detailed storage menu, accessible in the top menu bar or by pressing the CAPS hotkey. Wholesale items fetch a reduced rate compared to Vender Orders in non endless modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/793b749e420d257644a6359c0618ff2eb1a00d5f.png

Intuitive Selection: Easily select one, multiple, or all items by clicking on the desired crop or inventory item. Convenient buttons for selecting none and selecting all are located in the top right-hand corner.

Total Price Calculation: The wholesale panel calculates the total combined price for selected items. Adjust the quantity of each item to sell using the slider or buttons at the bottom. The slider allows adjusting the selling quantity from 1-100%. 

For example, if Cabbages, Carrots and Beets are selected and the farm has 

 10 Cabbages,
 23 Carrots,
 50 Beets 

with a Sell amount of 50% the button will sell the following as a combined order. 

 5 Cabbages,
 11 Carrots,
 25 Beets

Expanded Selection: Non-crop items like eggs, honey, and vegetable oil can now also be sold, with stable seasonal prices. Add these items to wholesale orders.

Reputation Points Bonus: Earn Reputation Points for every $10,000 on each wholesale sale, providing an additional incentive for successful transactions.

Automatic Chicken Feeder and Chicken Run Improvements
An automatic feeder can now be added to each chicken run. Use the Secondary Action key (Right click or gamepad X) to upgrade each run. The upgrade cost is $512.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/56dbb35e6f2e10264be572987428c96c041a3e6e.jpg

The automatic feeder can be selected to use Cabbage, Carrots, Lettuce, Tomatoes or None from the farm’s storage. The feeder will automatically pull the selected crop from storage if no food is planted inside the run. Selecting ‘None’ will turn off the feeder. 

The chicken run will process as normal and produce an egg if food is present, checking the current acre for an available cover crop or commercial crop for food first. If food is not present in the run, chickens will then draw from the automatic feeder, ensuring constant egg production. Be sure to keep the selected crop stocked in the farm's storage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/2e95fa44a1c2d48263c514aba01c4fa5cd126270.jpg

 Progress Indicator:  A progress bar is now displayed in the Chicken Run's world widget, indicating the time until the next acre in the run is ready for grazing.
 Nighttime Animations: Chickens now rest at night, with animations reflecting their sleep state.
 Early Wake-up: Animals now wake up at 7 am, two hours earlier than before.



Bio Diesel Refinery & Oil Press Updates:

 Auto Shutoff: The Biodiesel Refinery now automatically halts production if fuel storage is full. It no longer produces or consumes input items if storage is at max
 Replaced Refinery world widget text from "rate" to "gallons / hour".
 The Oil Press can now be turned off by selecting ‘None’ as an input with Secondary Action Key (right click or Gamepad X)
 The Oil Press widget style has been updated to match the chicken run’s


Endless Mode Enhancements

 Reputation points can now be earned in endless mode by selling orders totaling $10k or more
 The current amount of Rep Points is now displayed in the license menu, this is helpful while in endless mode when the Reputation Level bar is removed.
 Buttons for opening the available orders tab have been removed in endless mode. 
 Licenses for increasing max orders have also been removed in endless mode.
 Removed the text ‘Orders are Optional’ when the endless mode preset is selected in the new game mode selection window.


Additional Improvements

 Increased the size of the tool selection buttons in the primary toolbar
 Added additional descriptions for each license
 Added tractor world icon to indicate right click ( or X on the gamepad) is used to cancel tractors
 The world widgets are now opened and usable for placeables larger than one acre if the mouse or selection tool is over the non primary cell
 Added a back option to the game mode selection window during the start new game process


Bug Fixes

 Fixed placeable item cost world widgets rotation direction on newly selected tools.
 Additional tractor collision checks have been added for more consistent results. 


Thank you all again for playing ACRES and being such a great community,
Jimi

notes.title: Optimizations, GPU Performance Scaling & Additional QoL features
notes.content:
Greetings ACRES Community,

I extend my heartfelt appreciation to each and every one of you for your amazing support and valuable feedback. Your dedication to ACRES has been instrumental in shaping the game's evolution.

In this mid-week patch, I am pleased to share that significant strides have been made in enhancing performance. The game thread now operates at a remarkable sub-2ms CPU frame time on my development machine, equipped with an i9-10850K. Furthermore, efforts have been directed towards optimizing GPU usage, addressing concerns raised by the community.

The challenges in GPU overhead predominantly stem from Unreal 5's cutting-edge features, such as Nanite, Global Dynamic Lighting, Shadows Maps, and advanced Antialiasing methods. While these features undoubtedly elevate the visual and immersive aspects of the game, there's a conscientious effort to balance their benefits against the associated performance costs within ACRES.

To empower you with more control over your gaming experience, this patch introduces additional options in the video settings. These enhancements aim to provide a tailored balance between graphics quality and optimal performance, catering to a wider range of hardware configurations.

Your continued support and feedback remain invaluable as we navigate these improvements. Together, we are committed to refining ACRES and ensuring an exceptional gaming experience for all.

Thank you for being an integral part of the ACRES journey.

-Jimi

notes.title: Biodiesel Production Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the future of farming! This update brings a revolutionary shift to your agricultural endeavors, granting you unparalleled control over your fuel production with the Biodiesel Refinery. Say goodbye to external markets as you harness the capability to convert vegetable oil into diesel fuel, all at the tip of your fingers. Join us in this transformative journey towards self-sustainability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/4426e274a919900768edb9e09dec25228869e7e9.png
Biodiesel Refinery
Empower your farm with self-sufficiency! The Biodiesel Refinery now grants you the ability to produce your own diesel fuel, eliminating the need to rely on external markets. Oil Press
The Oil Press introduces versatility to your crops. It converts selected crops from your storage into vegetable oil. By default, corn is transformed into vegetable oil, but the Oil Press can also process sunflowers. Switch between crops with a right-click or the X button on your gamepad, but note that changing crops resets the production timer.

Introducing a new sell percentage of inventory button, defaulting to selling 33% of the total crop inventory. Adjust the rate with the slider, ranging from 1% to 100%. Enjoy a visual update and confirmation audio sounds for the sell buttons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/12203b78dea1a5a59e1e098da432884c7ff87705.png

 Unlock specific tools using reputation points.

 Choose to disable tractor collision in the game settings.

 Reduced CPU tick overhead in static world objects, addressing high utilization rates on high-end GPUs caused by slower CPU bottlenecks.


Bugfixes:

 Tool tooltip size detail row now updates seamlessly with dark mode UI.
 Fixed gamepad navigation order for next/previous tool category (LB/RB or L1/R1).


With these updates, your farm is not just a piece of land but a dynamic ecosystem, responding to your every command with precision and efficiency. From the enhanced Oil Press operations to the streamlined Harvest Sell Buttons, and a myriad of other features and bugfixes, your farming experience has reached new heights. Embrace these changes, cultivate your legacy, and watch your virtual farm flourish like never before! 

Happy farming!
Jimi

notes.title: Introducing Reputation Points, Crop Genetics Research & Upgradeable Licenses
notes.content:
Greetings, valued ACRES community! I'm thrilled to bring you the latest game-changing updates that promise to take your farming experience to new heights. As a solo developer, your feedback and enthusiasm have fueled my commitment to enhancing every aspect of ACRES. Reputation Points, Crop Genetics Research, and a host of other exciting changes are the fruits of your invaluable input. These innovations are aimed at providing you with even more control, customization, and enjoyment as you cultivate your virtual farm. I can't wait to see how these updates transform your ACRES journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/d3be84f360c973cc596129a781d626935f032d03.jpg

Reputation Points
Introducing Reputation Points, a new currency in ACRES. Earn these valuable points by successfully completing orders. Regardless of the order's size, each completed task rewards you with one reputation point, adding a strategic dimension to tackling smaller orders, even when they offer lesser profits. Reputation Points serve as the gateway to unlocking an array of upgrades, research opportunities, and farm improvements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/d4615642da36b49aecb4a8d0ae9eb637a85b4b7f.png

Upgrading the Primary Tractor
Your trusty, first tractor, nestled in the home barn, can now undergo significant upgrades through the license tab, using Reputation Points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/b184072c9c4024b24dac119534fd7a5da59da2e4.jpg

Changes to Max Orders
Say goodbye to automatic increases in max orders upon completing orders. Instead, you can unlock more orders in the license tab by utilizing your hard-earned Reputation Points. This revamped system empowers players with enhanced control and customization of their farms, introducing fresh incentives. Additionally, the new max order system permits players to reduce the maximum number of new orders, exclusively affecting future orders while leaving current ones unaffected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/c3676d7a20f978bfe3b1ca9b262c200ce4bf2120.jpg
Selectable & Upgradeable Licenses
I'm thrilled to introduce the game-changing feature of Selectable and Upgradeable Licenses. Here's how it works: Each license is now optional and can be handpicked by you, the player. When you unlock a license, it seamlessly integrates the corresponding items into your order request queue. But that's not all; as you increase the license level, you'll notice a surge in the number of items required for orders and a substantial boost in their financial payouts. This upward journey in license levels does come at a cost in Reputation Points, so spend wisely. The great news is that you also have the flexibility to reduce a license level, which will return Reputation Points to you. This ingenious system is already at play with the farmstead license, granting access to lucrative honey and egg orders.

Crop Genetics Research
ACRES now features Crop Genetics Research, enabling you to enhance each crop variety, resulting in higher-performing variants. Access this feature through the new gene research tab. Each upgraded variant boasts distinct attributes from its parent variety, necessitating varying nutrient values. Unlock these upgraded varieties using your Reputation Points and switch between heirloom and hybrid variants at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/efc46ccc1ef4d9f78a7d874a1c9e925e35f22827.png


Livestock Animation Optimization
This week the livestock animation system received an overhaul. The costly skeletal animation has been replaced with a highly efficient static vertex animation framework. All animations are now compressed into texture files, promising faster and smoother performance. This revamped framework is already visible in the chicken runs, paving the way for a more robust livestock system, capable of handling a multitude of diverse animals, and setting the stage for exciting new additions to ACRES.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/347b53ddc31236b43a712fb0c77a8f86e5e8650f.gif

Optional Day Cycle & Weather Animation
Listening to player feedback, we've made sky lighting and animations optional. By toggling off the "Animate Sky & Day Cycle" setting in the game options, you can disable sun movement, nighttime darkness, and other sky-based visibility effects. Rain will still be visible on the screen, minus the visibility-blocking effects. Note that toggling these settings on or off may require a game restart for the changes to take full effect. This option can also be accessed in the main menu settings.


Additional Updates

 Display numbered key bindings on the HUD for Action Category Buttons.
 Increased camera movement distance.
Tool tooltips for buildings now display their size with Height x Width.
 Quickly exit the pause menu using the ESC key.
 Keep track of time with minute updates in the time clock.
 Adjust livestock animation quality with a new setting in the video options.
 Added amendments notice in tooltip "Amendments offer an instant yet costly solution for improving soil conditions. Use Cover Crops as a more economical but time-intensive alternative."
 Added soil structure message in the tutorial
 Updated Localizations
 Hovering over current game mode icon now displays tooltip with each custom setting in game


Bugfixes

 Included updated key bindings for AZERTY layouts
 Removed prefix size 3 in tractor barn tooltip name


I'm excited to see how these enhancements reshape your ACRES experience. Your valuable feedback continues to inspire me to innovate and elevate the game. As you embark on new farming adventures, remember that your journey is at the heart of ACRES, and I'm here to support and grow with you. Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and happy farming!

Jimi

notes.title: New Calm Mode, Weed Management Tools & Dark UI Update
notes.content:
Hello All! 

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support and valuable suggestions. I've been diligently going through all your comments and working tirelessly to implement the requested features and improvements to make ACRES the best game it can be.

As we embark on week two of this journey, I'm thrilled to introduce several exciting updates:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/a59589ce204457d881d827345183f4f9099ef05c.jpg
Calm Mode: Plants Thrive on Water Alone
In response to your requests for a more relaxed gaming experience, I've made significant adjustments to Calm Mode. Soil requirements to grow healthy crops have been relaxed. Plants now only require water to grow and no longer experience stress due to soil nutrient deficiencies. Soil nutrients are still present but they will not restrict growth if conditions are not met.  This mode now offers a more simplified gameplay experience, where soil conditions have a minimal impact.

Challenge Mode: Mandatory Orders
Challenge Mode has undergone a significant change as well. In this mode, all orders are now mandatory; there's no opting out. Each morning, all orders will automatically be added to your queue, up to the maximum allowed. This resembles the "Auto Select All Orders" option, but in Challenge Mode, it's strictly enforced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e928f91ec3f10b712be9105337d206087484d321.jpg

New Weed Management Tools
I'm excited to introduce three new tools to help you combat those persistent weeds:

Plastic Mulch Layer
A new cultivator implement has arrived, the Plastic Mulch Layer! Say goodbye to weeds throughout your crops' entire lifecycle with the Plastic Mulch Layer.  While plasticulture is relatively expensive, it guarantees maximum growth by eliminating weeds completely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/9294e2439bdffaae2dc3844a7d1617d195bfa953.png

Chemical Weed Suppression
Weeds can now also be suppressed with two new amendments: Natural Herbicide and Commercial Herbicide. When applied, these herbicides gradually hinder weed growth over several days. Natural Herbicide is effective for seven days, while Commercial Herbicide can keep weeds at bay for up to thirty days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/9ca5f08b6e266d1964154c92ec6b19a0519fdb4c.jpg

Natural Herbicide is a vinegar and salt solution that also lowers soil pH and water in the acre. The commercial alternative is pH balanced and doesn't affect soil nutrients, but it's pricier and has negative effects on soil structure.

Dark Mode UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/fd7df241fa3922c8a38492e94314ad8d1e2eb176.jpg
ACRES now features an optional dark mode for the HUD. You can enable it in the Settings -> Game menu.

Additional changes:

 Added support to save Tractor Control Devices current state.
 Increased size and opacity of amendments meu to improve readability.
 Added new Rock Dust amendment for an additional source of magnesium and micronutrients
 Separated Placeables category into 3 new tool categories: Tools, Buildings and Livestock to may room for upcoming additions. 
 Increased night time brightness.
 Moved saving icon to lower left corner.


Once again, I want to extend my heartfelt appreciation to all of you for helping make ACRES a fantastic community. Your feedback and support mean the world.

Jimi

Going into EA, my goal was to establish a solid core and stable gameplay loop for ACRES. Now that we are here, the journey to version 1.0 will focus on developing deeper mechanics, extending playtime, and providing tools to make managing large fields more feasible.

To kick off the Early Access progress, I'm introducing exciting updates in Week 1:

EcoBalance pH Pro
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f681164b598f7f79ea0f2101c6f9f0970cb07f23.jpg
Harnessing advanced sensor technology, this tool automatically adjusts soil pH according to your preferences by seamlessly controlling mineral levels. While it's a pricier alternative to manually amending the soil, it significantly streamlines pH management at scale. You can find the EcoBalance pH Pro in the amendments tools category, with four selectable presets:


 Neutral : pH 7.0
 Slightly Acidic : pH 6.1
 Acidic : pH 5.8
 Slightly Basic pH 7.8


These presets are easily accessible in their dedicated menu, much like the amendments menu, and your previous selections are stored for convenience.

5 Row Cultivator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/0bb20b6f91daf29ad89dfdfedd6965b25951f0d9.jpg
For those enthusiastic about weed removal, the 5-row cultivator has arrived! It joins the cultivator category alongside the 1 and 3-row cultivators. This also means there is a steam achievement awaiting!


Multiple Save Slots 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/6f0647fdaa298b6c929d9cffa5c8c6d48b9c9303.jpg
ACRES now boasts five save slots, allowing you to save new games with different modes in separate files while preserving progress in previous operations. Each save slot has its own file and additional backups at 1, 5, 10, and 20-minute intervals, creating a total of 25 different save files. Continuing a game will load the previously selected slot, and choosing a new slot will designate the future saving location.

Beehive Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/616244bd0ca88b5159e2e6018576aa7d24b8e738.jpg
The beehive multiplier now accumulates when multiple beehives are present, with up to 8 beehives influencing each acre. Additionally, the range of beehives has expanded to a 16x16 acre area, quadrupling the original 8x8 range. The move tool will now display this range when relocating existing hives.


Additional Updates

 A low fuel warning notifies you when your fuel drops below 100 gallons.
 We've added a new overall quality setting in the video options to automatically adjust all properties.
 A global illumination quality setting is now available to tailor lighting quality to your computer's hardware.
 Chicken animations now sync with the game speed.
 The seed selection menu now displays how many of a particular crop are already harvested in storage.
 Additional guides for best practices on using chicken runs and beehives have been added

Bugfixes

 I've resolved the crash associated with right-clicking while placing a water gauge.
 Beehive saving has been fixed to prevent duplication of hives after loading a game.


Thank you for your valuable feedback and support. Together, we'll continue to grow ACRES into an even more immersive and enjoyable experience.

notes.title: Order Selection, UX Updates + Ready for EA
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

First off, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for your support, from wishlisting to spreading the word about ACRES. Your enthusiasm has been nothing short of incredible! We're gearing up for the highly anticipated Early Access release on October 17th, and we can't wait to have you join us on this exciting journey.

This week's update brings some exciting changes that will enhance your farming experience in ACRES. We've listened to your feedback and have made several improvements, including changes to the way you receive orders and a rebalance of the reputation system.


Incoming Order Selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e3e3df55ed272cf21a1e1b9e5fea8e35d8a8529b.gif
Our brand-new order selection menu puts you in the driver's seat! Every day, as the sun rises, you'll have the chance to select from three fresh orders. You can now choose which orders you want to take on, allowing you to tailor your farming experience to your liking. The power to decide is in your hands!
Earning higher reputation allows the farm to take on more orders. Default popup window can be toggled on or off throughout the game based on current order pressures. Select "Auto Select All" to always receive all incoming orders and having a constant stream of revenue. 

As you build your reputation in the farming world, you'll unlock the ability to handle even more orders. We've also added a nifty feature that lets you toggle the order selection popup window on or off, depending on the current order pressures. Feeling bold? Opt for "Auto Select All" to automatically accept all incoming orders and maintain a steady stream of revenue.

Harvesting, One Row at a Time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/db9afcc80cc729214c41ba106420cb1acfb97619.png
I've made a significant adjustment to the single-row harvester, moving it one row to the side for a more authentic and meticulous crop-harvesting experience. Additionally, I've given the harvester a fresh look, addressing its previous resemblance to a baler. :) We hear your feedback and are dedicated to continuously improving the gameplay experience!

Taking Control of Time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/e196634ff917f18bf98520f813a8fcb1763a9961.jpg
In response to numerous requests, I've added a new game speed option: Pause. Now, alongside the existing slow, 1x, 3x, and 10x speeds, you can halt time altogether. For all you strategy aficionados out there, you'll be delighted to know that the spacebar serves as your quick pause button. When you're ready to resume, the game will pick up right where you left off at your last selected speed. you'll be delighted to know that the spacebar serves as your quick pause button. When you're ready to resume, the game will pick up right where you left off at your last selected speed. Enjoy the game at your own pace!

Soil Property Bars
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/0bde63843f56a60c5723489f390af882ce2f2d09.jpg
Each soil property now has its own progress bar on the HUD, enabling swift visual assessments and illustrating your farm's health and productivity better than before. Keep an eye on these bars to make sure your soil is at its has enough nutrients for crop growth.

Feeding Chickens the Smart Way
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f58133dd7bd1f88941fb0ee6577b668467c80f0b.png
We've introduced a nifty feature that lets you hand-plant crops right within the chicken runs. This comes with a host of benefits. As chickens require a well-balanced diet to lay eggs consistently, this new option ensures your feathered friends stay content and well-fed, all without the hassle of relocating the run to a new row. A win-win for both you and your clucking companions!



Additional Updates
 Chickens now contribute to reducing soil compaction at a faster rate.
 The Farmstead License for Honey and Eggs has been made more accessible, requiring only 25 completed orders.
 Tractor animation speed is now synchronized with the game speed, for a seamless gaming experience.
 You can now easily access the Incoming Orders and Global Storage Menu by hitting the TAB key.
 We've included a handy guide for managing loans effectively.
 Experience a progressive order completion compensation multiplier. The more orders you complete, the more rewarding your payouts become.


Bug Squashing
 The Master Audio Slider is now in perfect working order.
 The harvester no longer collides with itself in certain scenarios.
 UI text wrapping for localized fonts has been fixed for a smoother interface.


With these updates, ACRES is taking another big step towards offering the best farming experience possible. We can't wait to see you on the farm when Early Access kicks off on October 17th. Get ready to grow, harvest, and manage your way to agricultural success!

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and prepare to embark on your farming adventure like never before. See you on the farm!

notes.title: Chickens, Beehives & Cover crops!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for wishlisting and helping to spread the word about ACRES! It's truly heartwarming to witness the level of interest and support we've received. I've been hard at work on several updates as we draw nearer to the release date. I'm thrilled to announce that we have now officially confirmed the release date: October 18, 2023.

Chicken Runs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/f58133dd7bd1f88941fb0ee6577b668467c80f0b.png
Exciting news! Our farm is now home to a flock of chickens! These clever creatures will be residing in specially designed chicken runs, which can be strategically positioned alongside our crop rows. What makes them so valuable is their ability to naturally break down plants and cover crops, rejuvenating the soil without the unfortunate soil compaction that can occur with tractors.

Here's how it works: The chicken runs will systematically cycle through each acre cell, diligently feasting on and digging into the planted crop within that cell. Once they've completed their work in each cell of the run, they can either circle back to the original cell or can be relocated to a different row on the farm. Keep in mind that each chicken run installation will have an initial cost of $2,880, and should you decide to move them, it will incur an additional charge of $13.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/d791aac0af0cc7e240e03da669fdadb7e3e2bb54.gif
Welcome to a new era of farming efficiency and sustainability with our feathered friends!


Beehives
We're thrilled to introduce another exciting addition to our farm: beehives! These beehives are a one-cell buildable item that you can easily access from the placeables menu, and each one comes at a cost of $950. What makes them truly invaluable is their remarkable ability to reduce pollination times for adjacent acres, resulting in a 10% acceleration in crop growth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/4ac2e6d722f98f4a5134f0f0d3a9dd9ca733edf5.png

The magic of beehives extends in an impressive 8-cell square radius, benefiting all the cells within that range. With these industrious bees by our side, we're looking forward to faster and more bountiful harvests. Beehives are yet another step towards enhancing the productivity and prosperity of our farm.

Cover Crops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/318e0a5fcf6f50191e103d40ac89507586d4ee2c.jpg
Even more exciting news for our farming endeavors! We've introduced cover crops to our lineup, offering you a fantastic way to nurture and rejuvenate the soil in between harvests. These cover crops play a vital role in replenishing the soil, gradually infusing it with essential nutrients during each growth cycle.

Just like our cash crops, cover crops, once they reach maturity, can also be seamlessly incorporated back into the soil using our efficient plow tools. The unique advantage of cover crops lies in their higher dig-in values, ensuring that they contribute even more nutrients to the soil, enriching it for future plantings.

For your convenience, here are the current nutrient values for each of our cover crops:

Soil Structure
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/ce1ee82575d91d39057fe268bcc2b50ad6bd293d.png
Soil structure for each acre can be monitored in the lower right hand screen with the vertical bar.


In this latest ACRES update, we're excited to introduce a significant enhancement to our soil health system by incorporating soil structure values. This innovative addition has a direct impact on the growth rate of your crops.

A higher soil structure value can supercharge the growth rate of each crop, potentially boosting it up to an impressive 1.5 times its normal speed. Conversely, a lower soil structure value can hamper growth, slowing it down to as little as 0.2 times the usual rate.

Soil structure isn't static; it's influenced by various factors, including the manipulation of the soil through tractor use, tools, and the crops themselves. Tractors, in particular, have a compaction effect on the soil, decreasing its structure. Larger tractors exert a more significant compaction force.

However, there are proactive measures you can take to enhance soil structure. Introducing organic matter into the soil through methods such as cover crops, chicken runs, and peat moss will elevate the soil structure, providing your planted crops' roots with ample space to thrive and flourish. It's a dynamic system that empowers you to optimize your farm's productivity like never before.


Fuel Storage Tanks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/0b3cd0f0ba54cd27974c626f5527e5aabdadd343.jpg

Introducing a game-changing addition to our farm infrastructure: fuel storage tanks! These innovative buildable items are here to revolutionize our fuel management system by expanding our maximum fuel capacity.

As a starting point, our farm can initially hold 200 gallons of diesel fuel. However, the beauty of the fuel storage tanks lies in their ability to augment this capacity. Each additional fuel storage tank you purchase and build will further boost the fuel storage by an additional 200 gallons.

Designed to be compact and efficient, these fuel storage tanks occupy a 1x3 cell space and are available at a cost of $3,450 each. With these tanks in place, we'll have the power to store and manage our fuel resources like never before, ensuring that we're always ready for the demands of a busy farming season.

With feedback and suggestions noted, I have been hard at work this week implementing feature requests and quality of life improvements. Changes in the upcoming patch include:

Upgradable Seed Bins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/a6f4636b032b7314a02a064f3ef7a784e29a6697.jpg
Seed bins are now upgradable after they have been built. This allows players to increase their seed storage capacities without having to build multiple bins of the same type. [olist]
 $369 : 4

Gamemode playstyle selection

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/271b6cb823977353eac0b5345957c06bfe6c8b13.jpg
To accommodate all kinds of players, ACRES now has selectable game mode or difficulty options on the start of a new game. In addition to the original Normal and Endless modes, now available are Calm and Challenge modes. The main difference between Normal, Calm and Challenge are the amount of crops requested in each order and the amount of time given to complete the order. For a full breakdown, be sure to watch the latest ACRES devlog.

Gamemodes

 Calm For hobby farmers and those looking to unwind. Simplified order quantities with minimized time constraints.
 Normal For market growers looking for success. Standard order quantities with a gradual increase in time pressure.
 Challenge For the seasoned farm manager looking to be tested. Market demand exceeds availability, escalating time pressure.
 Endless Farm without pressure and sell crops directly out of storage. No orders, no time requirements.


Crop Ready Indicators
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/999ac4d38365750e9e22d5d0967122bad8d6fcb1.jpg

Double column seed menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44276295/afbacca893b9288c75bd3d021fb772b4d3ebaa0a.jpg
To reduce the amount of scrolling, the seed selection menu is now 2 columns wide. Full controller navigation is still supported. Thanks to those who made this suggestion, the menu is now much more manageable in a hurry with all the seed types. 

Additional updates

 Increase in fertilizer N-P-K values
 Increased water gained during rain events
 Backup and support to  load previous autosave files
 World UI widgets for tractor control device and seed bins
 Seed bins and tractor barns are now destroyable
 Bugfix for order progress bars not updating after fast harvesting
 Support to save custom key bindings
 Default speed keyboard bindings changed to F1, F2, F3
 Option to escape build mode and have no active tool selected. Exit current tool is mapped to the pause input action with default keybinding ESC. Pressing ESC a second time with pause the game. Thanks again for the support and interest in ACRES! We're are very excited about the progress and can't wait for launch.
